desc: Parse input and store bad intervals.
Precompute a boolean array `rep` for representable distances up to 5000 using BFS, and find threshold T such that all D ≥ T are representable.
Build the list of good intervals.
For G0, compute initial tail reachable positions.
For each subsequent good interval Gi, compute entry positions and next tail reachable positions.
For the last good interval GM, check if N is reachable.
Test solution on provided samples and additional edge cases (e.g., M=0, large N, consecutive bad intervals, minimal A/B) to ensure correctness; fix any issues.
